summary: Add multi-step exam practice that connects the Factor Theorem to cubic division and factorisation.

improvements.why: All seven existing items are one-mark Find or Calculate tasks; none asks students to show a factor and then use it to factorise a cubic.
improvements.what: Add two distinct multi-part structured questions using Show that followed by Hence: require the full substitution proving a proposed $ax+b$ or $ax-b$ factor, algebraic division to obtain the quotient, and complete factorisation. Use fresh cubics, not the two already used throughout the pack; include method and accuracy scheme points and three progressive hints per item.

improvements.why: The current practice does not test finding an unknown coefficient from a stated remainder or factor condition.
improvements.what: Add one parameter problem where $f(b/a)=0$ determines an unknown coefficient and one where a given nonzero remainder determines it. Use both signs of linear divisor across the pair, exact fractional answers where needed, and worked explanations that distinguish zero remainder from a nonzero one.
